The fingers on the fretboard appear slightly muddled and lack distinct separation. The thumb position seems anatomically awkward or partially merged with the neck of the guitar.
The microphone pole seems to vanish into the shirt/torso area without a clear clip attachment point, creating a slight floating or fusion effect.
